title: Kadodi language
extract: Samvedi is the language spoken by the Samvedi Brahmin and Kupari community in Vasai, Maharashtra, India. The language has evolved as an intermediate dialect of Marathi and Konkani, incorporating significant lexical and phonetic influences from Portuguese as well as elements found in Goan speech patterns.
